opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members must be submitting or presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend; eligibility varies with membership category; members can apply for up to three meetings in a single application.
opportunities.summary: Supports member engagement at Society meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society‑sponsored events by covering registration, conference dinner and a contribution toward travel and accommodation.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members whose host institution is willing to administer the award; projects must support novel physiology teaching; funds cannot be used for salary, conference attendance, or commercial gain; resources must be made available to the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members with a host institution willing to administer; applications must be physiological in nature; funds must be used within 12 months; animal costs, consumables and small equipment are permitted; cannot be used for salary or conference attendance.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, finalize projects, and promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; events must take place after the application window; applicants must display the Society’s logo and promote the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars, or outreach events at their organisation.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members; host institution must administer; funds must be used within 12 months; cannot be used for salary or conference attendance; members normally only awarded once.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, covering consumables, equipment, and other justified expenses.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer; projects must directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences (teaching or research).
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles within the physiological community.
